name: Cucumber Mint Shot
subtitle: the cooling one, a short glass of jal-jeera without the jeera

steps.text: Blend the cucumber and mint with 50ml water.
Strain through a sieve. Cucumber gives up its juice easily, so do not overwork it.
Stir in the lemon juice, black salt and roasted cumin.
Chill briefly and serve. It should taste of salt as much as of cucumber.

storage: Same day. Cucumber juice separates and turns flat overnight.

provenance.note: This is jal-jeera stripped back and served short. Black salt is what makes it taste Indian rather than merely green.
